leaks.title: Internet price rose after 12 months, but the agreement promised 24
leaks.expected_action: Draft a message to Skylink citing the 24-month Bonus Saver term; ask to restore $79 and credit the $40 overcharged to date.

leaks.title: StreamBox is paid twice: directly (Ben) and through Apple (Maya)

deadlines.what: next Apple renewal; cancel at least a day before (by 2026-11-20)

leaks.expected_action: Recommend cancelling one (the Apple-billed subscription, started 21 June); explain how. Optionally draft a refund request for duplicate months.
leaks.difficulty_notes: The card descriptor says only APPLE.COM/BILL; the product is revealed only in the Apple receipt emails.

leaks.title: Gym annual fee renews in 9 days; the 14-day cancellation deadline passed on 14 Nov
leaks.expected_action: Draft a cancellation notice plus a goodwill request to waive the annual fee: no visits since 3 Sep, Ben tried to cancel (calendar reminder). Be honest that the notice period was missed.
leaks.difficulty_notes: Requires date arithmetic (14 days before 28 Nov) against 'today' = 19 Nov.

leaks.title: Kids' reading app trial converted to $14.99/month and is unused
leaks.expected_action: Recommend cancelling; optionally ask for a refund of the most recent month.

leaks.title: Plumber invoice KP-20418 paid twice (card and bank transfer)
leaks.expected_action: Draft a refund request quoting invoice KP-20418 and both receipts (R-77311, R-77402); ask for $385.00 back to the card or account of their choice.

leaks.title: Car insurance renewal up 31%, with a cheaper like-for-like quote in hand
leaks.expected_action: Draft a retention request to Wattle referencing the loyalty discount drop and the $1,109 quote; surface the decision (switch vs retain) before 4 Dec.
leaks.difficulty_notes: Same cover, same agreed value and excess: the agent should verify the quote is comparable.

leaks.title: Electricity bill based on an inflated estimated reading

amounts.method: Photo reads 47,006 kWh on 30 Oct. Back out ~4 days at 12.1 kWh/day (~49 kWh) to 26 Oct: ~46,957. Actual usage ~1,077 kWh vs billed 1,690 kWh: ~613 kWh x $0.285 = ~$175.

leaks.expected_action: Draft a bill-correction request attaching the meter photo and asking for a credit or refund of roughly $175 (already paid on 10 Nov).
leaks.difficulty_notes: Needs the image model to read the odometer, then arithmetic done in code. The red digit is the tenths: the reading is 47,006 kWh, not 470,060 (a realistic misread to guard against).

decoys.title: Mobile plan rose $55.00 to $57.20 (4.0%)
decoys.why_not_a_leak: Plan terms provide for annual CPI indexation, the 4.0% notice was sent in advance, and 55.00 x 1.04 = 57.20 exactly.

decoys.title: Two $38.00 SchoolPay charges on the same day
decoys.why_not_a_leak: Different children, different references (OH-Y3-0908 vs PI-PR-0908), two separate excursion notices.
